La Concha bay promenade, Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Michelin gastronomy and Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum.

Overview

San Sebastián & Bilbao (Donostia · Bilbao) is one of the essential stops in Spain, located in the Basque Country region. La Concha bay promenade, Parte Vieja pintxo bars, Michelin gastronomy and Bilbao's Guggenheim Museum.

With direct connections via Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail, San Sebastián & Bilbao rewards a stay of 3–4 days so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

RegionBasque Country
Best timeApr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Suggested stay3–4 days
Good forBasque Country, Culture & Sightseeing, Food & Dining, Rail Hub

Neighbourhoods & areas

San Sebastián & Bilbao Historic Center & Old Town

Walkable core with historic architecture, pedestrian squares, and landmarks (San Sebastián & Bilbao Historic Center & Main Square).

Central Station & Transit Quarter

Convenient hub for Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail arrivals, luggage lockers, and business hotels.

Market & Dining District

Evening bistros, traditional halls, and food stalls serving Traditional San Sebastián & Bilbao House Specialty and Regional Basque Country Market Dish.

Where to stay by budget

Budget

Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of San Sebastián & Bilbao's central station or metro lines.

Mid-range

Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.

Luxury

Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.

Rough nightly ranges: hostels and capsule hotels often run a few thousand yen per person; business hotels commonly €8,000–€20,000 per room; upscale hotels and ryokan can be far higher, especially in peak seasons. See our accommodation guide.

Getting there

San Sebastián & Bilbao is served by Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

Getting around

The historic core of San Sebastián & Bilbao is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

Day trips & side trips

Scenic Regional Excursion from San Sebastián & Bilbao

30–60 minutes by regional train into the surrounding Basque Country countryside and nearby historic towns.

Neighboring Heritage Town

Combine morning sightseeing with a long local lunch featuring Artisanal Basque Country Pastry & Wine.

Best time to visit

Spring (April–June) and autumn (September–October) bring mild walking weather and harvest festivals to San Sebastián & Bilbao. Summer offers long daylight hours, while winter brings festive markets and lower hotel rates.

Local tips

  • Start at San Sebastián & Bilbao Historic Center & Main Square before 9:00 AM to beat day-trip tour groups.
  • Use contactless credit cards or mobile transit passes on San Sebastián & Bilbao buses, trams, and metro gates.
  • Order Traditional San Sebastián & Bilbao House Specialty at lunch for the best value set menus.
